guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026, monday.com currently expects:
● | Total revenue of $380 million to $382 million, representing year-over-year growth of approximately 14%.
● | Non-GAAP operating income of $68 million to $70 million and operating margin of approximately 18%, assuming a negative FX impact of 100 to 200 basis points.
